note: Built-in checklists, used when the CMS (Contentful) has no checklist for the equipment's type. Wording is our own summary of the monthly-inspection items; it is guidance for the technician, not a reproduction of the standard. A CMS checklist for the same type always takes precedence.

questions: In its designated place, mounted, and not obstructed or hidden
Operating instructions on the nameplate are legible and face outward
Safety pin and tamper seal are in place and unbroken
Full, judged by weighing or hefting
No visible damage, corrosion, leakage or clogged nozzle
Pressure gauge reads in the operable (green) range
Inspection tag is present and up to date
Equipment is where it should be and accessible
Identification label or serial number is legible
No visible damage, wear, corrosion or leakage
Safety devices and guards are present and intact
Safe to use until the next scheduled inspection
